lesson.create_character.title: Create Your Character
lesson.create_character.summary: Combine silhouette, expression, outfit shapes and story choices to design a character that belongs to you.
lesson.create_character.step.foundation: Start with a simple head, torso, pelvis and leg structure. Keep the silhouette readable before adding personality.
lesson.create_character.help.foundation: Use the center and shoulder anchors to compare the big masses. Focus on the overall shape, not tiny detail.
lesson.create_character.step.face: Add a simple face and expression. Let the features support the kind of character you are imagining.
lesson.create_character.help.face: Use the face guide for placement, then change the brows or mouth if a different expression fits your idea better.
lesson.create_character.complete.face: The character now has a readable expression.
lesson.create_character.step.outfit: Use a few large outfit shapes to change the silhouette. Think jacket, belt, boots or your own equivalent shapes.
lesson.create_character.help.outfit: Design from large shapes first. Decorative lines are optional; they are not needed to complete this step.
lesson.create_character.complete.outfit: The outfit shapes now support the character design.
lesson.create_character.step.yours: Now take control of the design. Change the silhouette, outfit, expression, accessories, role or story until the character feels like yours.
lesson.create_character.help.yours: Pick one idea—who they are, what they do, or what they carry—and let that idea guide your next choice. You do not need to match the teacher character.
lesson.create_character.complete.drawing: You combined construction and imagination into an original character design.
